prompt:
Image 1 is a pixel-art sprite sheet of a small chibi knight for a top-down 2D game, in 2 rows and 2 columns. Column 1 is turned three-quarters toward the viewer, column 2 three-quarters away from the viewer. Redraw this sheet exactly, with the same layout, the same 4 figures in the same positions, the same size, the same pixel-art style and the same flat solid pure magenta background, RGB 255,0,255. Do not move, resize or redraw the legs. Every hip, thigh, knee and boot stays on exactly the same pixels as in Image 1.

Change only one thing: keep only the legs. Remove the head, the helmet, the neck, the shoulders, the chest armour, both arms, the hands and the gloves, the belt and the blue waist guard or skirt. Draw what was hidden behind the waist guard: plain tight dark trousers that cover the hips and the thighs up to the waist, in a very dark neutral colour. The top edge of each figure is a straight waist line at the height of the belt in Image 1. Leave flat magenta above the waist line.

Keep only the plain dark hips, the thighs, the knees and the boots, in exactly the same pose.

Do not include: a belt, a skirt, a waist guard, arms, hands, a torso, a head, weapons, shields, text, labels, numbers, grid lines, ground, shadows, dust, effects, borders, watermark, or any other object. No soft gradients, blur or painterly rendering.
